sum: J.W. Mays, Inc. engages in the owns and operates commercial real estate properties in the United States. The company also leases commercial properties to tenants. Its properties are located in Brooklyn, Jamaica, Fishkill, Levittown, and Massapequa, New York; and Circleville, Ohio. J.W. Mays, Inc. was founded in 1924 and is based in Brooklyn, New York.
ceo: Mr. Lloyd J. Shulman (Chairman of the Board, President & CEO)
